metadata.record_scope: Aggregate municipal payroll only; no employee-level records are stored.

definitions.overtime_share: Overtime pay divided by regular pay plus overtime pay plus other pay.
definitions.department_driver: Department overtime pay in 2025 minus department overtime pay in 2024.
definitions.classification_note: NYC and San Francisco use published overtime fields. Chicago overtime is an analyst-classified proxy based on pay-element names.
